description: This file implements a React component for a persona analysis page in a Next.js application. It manages the UI for processing user documents, displaying progress steps, and rendering a draft persona once analysis is complete.

methods.name: AiIcon
methods.description: Renders a decorative AI icon with pulsing animation.

methods.name: ProgressBar
methods.description: Displays a progress bar with the current completion percentage.

methods.name: Particles
methods.description: Renders animated decorative particles for visual effect.

methods.name: PersonaAnalyzePage
methods.description: Main React component that shows the analysis process, progress, and final draft persona state.
